leg.text: Tetsuo Umezawa is the imperial champion of Madara when Bolas sends Overdark to reclaim the rebellious Edemi Islands, and Overdark plots to kill him, though his minions and serpent generator are defeated.
Overdark has Xira Arien infect Kei to lure Tetsuo to the islands, and Tetsuo and Ayesha kill the insect inside Kei, though Kei keeps his mutations.
Tetsuo's entourage is then forced to join the kentsu as punishment, and Tetsuo renounces his title as imperial champion and swears vengeance on Overdark.

He fights his way to the Imperial Shrine and kills Overdark, absorbing his powers, then draws Bolas to the Meditation Plane, destroys the shrine with Hage's hammer, and kills Bolas, after which his friends convince him to restore order to the empire.

chk.text: Tetsuo Umezawa wins the title of imperial champion by defeating Shasido Mayasi, and he duels the cat-dragon Wasitora at Sekana until an Elder Land Wurm interrupts, after which he spares her and she becomes champion's deputy.

Overdark lures him to the Edemis by having Xira Arien infect Kei with her larva, and Tetsuo defeats Orca and Arien and destroys the serpent generator, then leaves Argenti when Lady Caleria lets him go.
Bolas forces him to join the kentsu, and his loyalty weakens after their dishonorable behavior, then he finds Ayesha poisoned, Tor wounded and Kei killed, renounces his title and swears vengeance.
He kills Overdark in single combat, destroys the Imperial Shrine with Meteor Hammer so Bolas is defeated, and sets out with his friends to restore the chaotic empire.
